campos.palabras_clave: hover, button, opacity, lift, press feedback
campos.notas_framework: Bind on mouseenter/mouseleave; in React wrap in a ref + useEffect (or onMouseEnter/onMouseLeave props directly calling gsap.to); Use matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)') to skip non-essential motion and render the final state immediately
campos.hacer: Keep displacement under 2px so it reads as feedback not motion
campos.no_hacer: Don't animate layout-affecting props (width/height/margin) on hover
campos.notas_rendimiento: Runs on transform/opacity only so it stays on the compositor thread

campos.palabras_clave: hover, card, scale, tilt, cursor feedback
campos.notas_framework: Use gsap.quickTo(el, 'y') for cards with many hover targets to avoid re-creating tweens every event; Use matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)') to skip non-essential motion and render the final state immediately
campos.hacer: Pair with a matching mouseleave tween that reverses the same properties
campos.no_hacer: Don't leave the hover state stuck if the pointer leaves fast; always attach the reverse tween
campos.notas_rendimiento: quickTo() avoids GC churn on lists with 20+ hoverable cards

campos.palabras_clave: hover, magnetic, cursor follow, 3d tilt, removable event listener cleanup
campos.notas_framework: Keep a stable named pointer handler so cleanup removes the same function; in React/Vue return the removeEventListener cleanup; use gsap.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)') and render x/y at the final neutral state
campos.hacer: Clamp the pull strength (e.g. * 0.3) so the element never fully leaves its hit box
campos.no_hacer: Don't apply magnetic effect to more than 1-2 focal elements per screen; it becomes noisy
campos.notas_rendimiento: Use will-change: transform on the target element for smoother compositing

campos.palabras_clave: scroll, fade in, reveal, on view
campos.notas_framework: Requires the ScrollTrigger plugin registered once via gsap.registerPlugin(ScrollTrigger); Use matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)') to skip non-essential motion and render the final state immediately
campos.hacer: Keep the y offset small (8-16px) so it reads as a fade, not a slide
campos.no_hacer: Don't reveal below-the-fold content needed for SEO/crawlers as invisible-by-default without a no-JS fallback
campos.notas_rendimiento: toggleActions 'play none none reverse' avoids re-triggering on every scroll direction change

campos.palabras_clave: scroll, slide up, staggered section, reveal
campos.notas_framework: In React use useGSAP(() => {...}, { scope: containerRef }) from @gsap/react to auto-cleanup on unmount; Use matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)') to skip non-essential motion and render the final state immediately
campos.hacer: Scope the ScrollTrigger to the section container so it doesn't re-scan the whole page
campos.no_hacer: Don't stagger more than ~8 children; beyond that the last items feel laggy
campos.notas_rendimiento: Set scroller/markers: false in production; markers is dev-only

campos.notas_framework: Pinning needs the section to have deterministic height; recalc ScrollTrigger.refresh() after images/fonts load; Use matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)') to skip non-essential motion and render the final state immediately
campos.hacer: Use scrub: true or a small number (0.5-1.5) instead of instant jumps so it feels tied to the scrollbar
campos.no_hacer: Don't pin more than 1-2 sections per page; excessive pinning fights native scroll feel and hurts mobile UX
campos.notas_rendimiento: Pinning forces layout reflow; test on mid-tier mobile devices, not just desktop

campos.notas_framework: Select items with a stable class/data-attribute (not array index) so re-renders in React don't break targeting; Use matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)') to skip non-essential motion and render the final state immediately
campos.hacer: Keep per-item stagger delay small (0.02-0.04s) for lists longer than 10 items
campos.no_hacer: Don't stagger by more than 0.1s per item on long lists; total reveal time becomes sluggish
campos.notas_rendimiento: For virtualized lists, only animate items currently mounted in the DOM

campos.notas_framework: grid: 'auto' lets GSAP infer rows/columns from a CSS grid layout for a natural wave stagger; Use matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)') to skip non-essential motion and render the final state immediately
campos.hacer: Combine with from: 'center' for a bento-grid layout to draw the eye inward first
campos.no_hacer: Don't use back.out on dense data tables; the overshoot reads as sloppy on informational UI
campos.notas_rendimiento: Group DOM writes; avoid interleaving layout reads (getBoundingClientRect) between staggered tweens

campos.palabras_clave: stagger, wave, text reveal, split text
campos.notas_framework: SplitText is included with GSAP 3.13+; register it before use, review the current GSAP license, and keep a plain-text fade fallback; Use gsap.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)') to skip character motion and render the readable final state immediately
campos.hacer: Revert SplitText on unmount/cleanup (split.revert()) to restore original text nodes for accessibility tools
campos.no_hacer: Don't split-animate long paragraphs; reserve for short headlines (under ~8 words)
campos.notas_rendimiento: Splitting text creates one element per character; keep it to headline-length copy only for DOM size

campos.notas_framework: Pair with the router's transition hooks (Next.js App Router transitions, React Router's useNavigate, Vue Router's beforeEach/afterEach); Use matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)') to skip non-essential motion and render the final state immediately
campos.hacer: Preload the destination route's critical assets before the exit tween finishes
campos.no_hacer: Don't block navigation on animation; cap exit duration at ~250ms so the app never feels unresponsive
campos.notas_rendimiento: Exit animation should always resolve faster than entrance (asymmetric timing) so back/forward feels snappy

campos.notas_framework: Keep the overlay element mounted at the layout root (outside the page component) so it survives the route swap; Use matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)') to skip non-essential motion and render the final state immediately
campos.hacer: Show a lightweight loading indicator if the destination route's data fetch outlasts the overlay
campos.no_hacer: Don't tie the overlay's reveal directly to data-fetch completion without a max-wait timeout; a slow API stalls the whole transition
campos.notas_rendimiento: Prefer CSS transform (yPercent) over top/left to keep the overlay animation on the compositor thread

campos.notas_framework: Requires the GSAP Flip plugin; the 'from' and 'to' route must render the same element with a shared data-flip-id; Use matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)') to skip non-essential motion and render the final state immediately
campos.hacer: Verify the shared element exists in both DOM states before calling Flip.from to avoid a silent no-op
campos.no_hacer: Don't use shared-element transitions across more than one element pair per navigation; compounding Flips are hard to time correctly
campos.notas_rendimiento: Flip recalculates layout (FLIP technique) so test on low-end devices for jank

campos.notas_framework: Apply parallax to background/decorative layers only, never to text or interactive controls; Use matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)') to skip non-essential motion and render the final state immediately
campos.hacer: Keep the yPercent delta small (5-15) so foreground and background never desync distractingly
campos.no_hacer: Don't parallax body copy; it hurts reading comfort and can trigger motion sickness
campos.notas_rendimiento: will-change: transform on the parallax layer only; remove it after scroll settles to free GPU memory

campos.notas_framework: Layer count beyond 3-4 has diminishing visual return and multiplies scroll-listener cost; Use matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)') to skip non-essential motion and render the final state immediately
campos.hacer: Vary speed per layer (background slowest, foreground fastest) to sell the depth illusion
campos.no_hacer: Don't let parallax layers overflow their container; clip with overflow: hidden on the wrapper
campos.notas_rendimiento: Batch all layers under one ScrollTrigger container where possible instead of one per layer

campos.palabras_clave: loading, skeleton, shimmer, pulse, stop animation offscreen, visibility pause, reduced motion final state
campos.notas_framework: Kill the tween when content mounts or the component unmounts; pause it when its IntersectionObserver reports offscreen or document.visibilityState is hidden; when '(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)' matches kill the tween and set the final static skeleton state
campos.hacer: Use a CSS gradient background-position sweep rather than opacity pulsing; reads as 'loading' more clearly
campos.no_hacer: Don't run more than one shimmer loop per skeleton group; sync them under one timeline so the wave reads as a single unit
campos.notas_rendimiento: repeat: -1 tweens are cheap but must be explicitly killed on unmount or they leak in SPA route changes

campos.palabras_clave: progress, spinner, morphing loader, stop animation offscreen, visibility pause, timer cleanup, reduced motion final state
campos.notas_framework: In React use useGSAP scope for tween cleanup; add IntersectionObserver pause/resume when the loader is offscreen; when '(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)' matches kill the loop and show the final static loading state
campos.hacer: Cap total loop duration under ~1.5s so long waits don't feel like the UI froze on a single beat
campos.no_hacer: Don't use elaborate loaders for sub-300ms waits; they flash and feel worse than no indicator
campos.notas_rendimiento: Pause the timeline (tl.pause()) when the loading tab/view is not visible to save CPU on background tabs

campos.palabras_clave: carousel, auto-rotate, pause, focus, hover, reduced-motion, stop animation offscreen, visibility pause, timer cleanup, final state
campos.notas_framework: Use one cancellable timer; pause on focus, hover, offscreen, or hidden visibility; remove every listener and clear the timer on unmount; reduced motion stops rotation and renders the active slide as the final state
campos.hacer: Provide previous/next and play/pause controls; announce the current slide without moving focus
campos.no_hacer: Don't auto-advance without a visible stop control or continue while focus is inside
campos.notas_rendimiento: IntersectionObserver stops animation offscreen; visibilitychange stops hidden-tab work; cleanup disconnects the observer and clears the timer and listeners
